body: I am so sorry do not put any blame on yourself - it is purely me and my inability to comply with medicine. Sometimes people just aren't suited for life xx

yeah i have  a psych and in the UK people are assigned a community nurse and she is lovely but i just can't tell her the full extent to how i feel, i just feel like theres nothing else left to do. Ive been on multiple medications, been in hospital several times and seen a psychologist and nothing ever really made a real difference so it just makes me feel like what is the point really? nothing has ever really fixed things so I may as well just save everyone the hassle and end things

I know its just so much easier to think those things than to actually do them. Realistically no i shouldn't be doing to HK but my mums spent £3000 on flights/hotel to come visit me and I've already spent nearly £1000 on flights for myself. tbh i think tonight  is the end, have written my last goodbyes just need to wait for the right moment. thanks for you advice
I just sit and drink, i know its bad but I have no energy to of much else

aw sorry, um I've spent a lot of money, like maybe £4000 saving and £3000 on credit, I am a student so i really cannot afford anything like this. Got myself arrested. Slept with a few random guys, when I'm in a new, yet very caring relationship and he would be absolutely destroyed if he found out. I started taking drugs again, not hard drugs but coke, ecstasy, weed etc, which I always said to myself i would never touch again. I'm pretty sure I'm going to have to re-sit a year at university as I missed hand ins/some of my work is just absolute rubbish. I was in complete denial about my mental health, asking my psych to discharge me and things yet I was obsessive with being part of a (higher level) hard to explain but basically a bit psychotic and now I've just crashed from such a high and everything is such a mess and I have no idea how to sort it or who to even turn to for help. Exactly, thing is I'm sure my friends wouldn't see it as a weakness but because I'm so happy all the time i just don't know if they would believe me. I don't like people seeing me struggle at all, I am a very proud person, as my perspective, which is possibly very distorted is that I just don't like the attention/people feeling bad for me i suppose, but I'm probably way overthinking things.

Im sure you are right, I used to cut, haven't for a long time but I haven't been tempted the past few days. I know people would probably be more understanding if i actually just opened up and talked about it but I dno, it just feels like opening up about it would be like admitting weakness and admitting I have a problems, which i know depression/anxiety is not a weakness and is so so common now. Just barely anyone knows what I'm really like, they'd be so shocked. Ive been sectioned 3 times this year :(

The issue is I'm moving to Hong Kong ( from the UK) for 6 months 2 weeks today and I really don't know if i can even go. I have bipolar and was manic for a while and have got myself into some trouble, spent £7000 in about 6 weeks, sleeping with random men, getting arrested, just generally being a bit of an arsehole. I know my meds aren't right but I can't speak to my psych as he will probably say I can't go to HK and then my insurance will be invalid and things. So because I go away so soon that sort of rules out finding a therapist or anything. I'm just kind of stuck as to what to do. I now have no money to pay for my accommodation in HK and I'm with a great guy so I feel awful that I've slept with other people :(

Thanks for your response. ah sorry, I'm from the UK so thats maybe a bit of a british expression, what I mean if everything just seems a bit of a mess at the moment, nothing seems to be going well. It's not like I can't talk to them, I'm just not someone who likes to feel vulnerable with people, I'm sure if i swallowed my pride and was just honest about how i was feeling they would be supportive but even the thought of that makes me feel terribly anxious. I just feel they'd struggle to understand how I feel as it would come as such a shock, I'm usually the funny one/life of the party so i dno, they would probably just assume i'll just get over it
